name: proto-upstream-copy-outside-the-import-paths-of-a-held-path
description: Under proto.import_paths, an upstream copy no import root holds whose path from the target root is the import path of a file a root holds is shadowed by that file, since the two would share one schema_file: it publishes nothing, and a schema-unparsed note names it and that file. Since a schema file not read cleanly, a shadowed one included, may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
